features.name: Admin Listings Page
features.description: Client-side admin UI for listing management including stats, search, filters, and actions (approve/flag/reject/delete). Uses UI primitives from src/components/ui and mock data until API is implemented.

features.name: Reusable UI components
features.description: Design-system style UI primitives (Badge, Button, Card, Input, DropdownMenu, etc.) used across app pages and admin UI.

features.name: Sanity CMS Schemas & Studio
features.description: Sanity document schemas and studio configuration for content (listing, city, blogPost, author, siteConfig).

features.name: API routes & server logic
features.description: Server-side API endpoints for app integrations and webhooks (Stripe, Sanity previews, auth), located under app-next-directory/src/app/api or pages/api depending on structure.

features.name: Type definitions
features.description: Centralized TypeScript types for domain models (listings, users, sanity types).

features.name: Testing
features.description: Unit and integration tests using Jest and end-to-end tests with Playwright. Project contains examples and setup guides for tests.

features.name: Scripts & Dev tooling
features.description: Convenience scripts for setup and local dev (setup.sh, run-sanity-proxy.ps1, run_migration.py) and the monorepo pnpm workspace config.

features.name: Listings data model & fixtures
features.description: Sample data, quick test scripts for cities and listings, and fixtures used in unit tests and for local inspection.

features.name: Docs & project guides
features.description: Various onboarding and setup guides located across the repo; candidate files to consolidate into docs/ (README.md, WORKSPACE_SETUP.md, MONGODB_SETUP.md, QUICK_MONGODB_SETUP.md, JEST_SETUP_GUIDE.md, etc.).

features.name: CI / Release traces
features.description: Project contains CHANGELOG.md and some CI config hints; needs consolidation (GitHub Actions config may exist in .github/).
